title: EPA ECHO Environmental Compliance Search Input

facilityName.title: Facility / Company Name
facilityName.description: Name of the facility or operating company (e.g. 'Tesla', 'Amazon', 'Exxon').

city.title: City Name
city.description: City where the regulated facility is located.

naicsCode.title: NAICS Industry Code
naicsCode.description: North American Industry Classification System code (e.g. '336111' for Automobile Manufacturing).

significantNonComplianceOnly.title: Significant Non-Compliance (SNC) Only
significantNonComplianceOnly.description: Filter strictly for facilities currently flagged by the EPA as having Significant Non-Compliance.

maxRecords.title: Maximum Facility Records
maxRecords.description: Maximum number of facility records to return and push to the dataset.

outputMode.title: Output Mode
outputMode.description: Choose between detailed dataset records or a compact MCP executive risk summary.
